column1: # Routine lines of an Android run log that `dm/tools/log_digest.py --filter` leaves out: lines that repeat in a healthy run and say nothing about what went wrong.
# A deny-list: a line no row matches is kept, and a line that is a [RED], crash, FATAL, abort, signal, warning or error line, matches dm/tools/log_rules.tsv or is a stage
# milestone is kept even when a row matches it. Same regex rules as log_rules.tsv (Python re and Java java.util.regex). Columns: id, regex, note.
